skill_name: Name three benefits of using a chatbot to answer customer inquiries.
workflow: Three benefits of using a chatbot to answer customer inquiries are quick and accurate responses, enhanced customer experience, and cost savings. Chatbots can provide quick responses 24/7, help to reduce response times, and deliver accurate, personalized responses from a customer's perspective. They also free up customer service personnel to focus on more complex tasks, resulting in cost savings for the organization.
